entities.name: Timurid Renaissance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Timurid Renaissance, a transformative movement in Iran (1370–1501). Emerged from Hulagu sacks Baghdad, ending the Abbasid Caliphate and Genghis Khan destroys Nishapur, Merv, and other major Iranian cities. Catalyzed Timurid Iran and Cultural Flourishing and Husayn Bayqara.
